name: DeepSeek-TUI
body:
> **Codewhale** is the public product from Shannon Labs. The `codewhale`
> command, npm package, and release-asset names remain lowercase technical
> identifiers. The legacy npm package `deepseek-tui` is deprecated and
> receives no further releases. Users coming from v0.8.x legacy `deepseek` /
> `deepseek-tui` names should migrate with `docs/REBRAND.md`.

## Install

### Recommended — npm (one command, both binaries)

```bash
npm install -g codewhale
```

The wrapper downloads the matched runtime binaries from this Release and places them in the same directory.

### Docker / GHCR

```bash
docker run --rm -it \
  -e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" \
  -v codewhale-home:/home/codewhale/.codewhale \
  ghcr.io/hmbown/codewhale:v0.9.0
```

The image ships the `codewhale` dispatcher, `codew` shim, and `codewhale-tui` runtime. The `latest` tag is also updated on release.

### Cargo (Linux / macOS)

```bash
cargo install codewhale-cli codewhale-tui --locked
```

Both crates are required — `codewhale-cli` produces the `codewhale` dispatcher and `codew` shim, while `codewhale-tui` produces the interactive runtime that the dispatcher delegates to. Installing only one crate will fail at runtime with a `MISSING_COMPANION_BINARY` error.

### Manual download — platform archives (recommended)

Each archive below contains the `codewhale` dispatcher, `codew` shim, and `codewhale-tui` runtime, plus an install script:

| Platform | Archive | Install script |
|---|---|---|
| Linux x64 | `codewhale-linux-x64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| Linux ARM64 | `codewhale-linux-arm64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| Android ARM64 (Termux) | `codewhale-android-arm64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| macOS x64 | `codewhale-macos-x64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| macOS ARM | `codewhale-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | `install.sh` |
| Windows x64 (installer) | `CodeWhaleSetup.exe` | NSIS setup |
| Windows x64 | `codewhale-windows-x64.zip` | `install.bat` |
| Windows x64 (portable) | `codewhale-windows-x64-portable.zip` | —

name: tsukimi
body:
Inspired by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/107435, after a lot of work, we found a way to embed mpv's gpu-next vo into GTK4. It is treated as a child of `gtk::GraphicsOffload`, allowing the compositor to perform direct scanout. Unfortunately, from now on we will only support Wayland. During this work, we also made several crates that you may be interested in: 1. [Mutsumi](https://github.com/MutsumiUniverse/Mutsumi): A wl-proxy embedder with GTK4 UI wrappers. 1. [Danmakw](https://github.com/MutsumiUniverse/Danmakw): A danmaku renderer using Pango. 1. [Fughetta](https://github.com/MutsumiUniverse/Fughetta): A local media player built on top of Mutsumi. It should be able to handle most local playback scenarios. This is a large change, and it may still have some issues. If you run into any problems, please report them in the Issues. Hope you love this feature.

Picture 1: gpu-next vo inside player.



Picture 2: Direct scanout with gtk::GraphicsOffload.

name: NipaPlay-Reload
body:
# NipaPlay v1.11.0 更新日志

本次更新对多端 UI 架构进行了大规模重构，让电脑、平板和手机共享同一套功能与数据，同时新增了 Linux 外部播放器弹幕控制台、弹幕透明度与描边设置等多项实用功能，并修复了多个平台上的用户可见问题。

## 新功能

**多端统一 UI 架构与移动端播放器完善** ([#731](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/731))
将电脑、平板和手机从各自维护整套页面的旧结构，重构为共享语义数据与状态、由不同显示表面自动分配控件和布局的统一架构。桌面完整功能可自动同步到手机端，媒体库、库管理、设置、个人中心、下载器及弹幕工作流在各端保持一致；手机端采用底部主导航、右上角页面操作和上拉菜单子页面导航，并支持 iOS 26 原生控件。移动端横竖屏播放体验也一并重构，默认横屏、竖屏紧凑控制，播放器菜单改用统一的上拉菜单导航。

**Linux 外部播放器弹幕控制台** ([#730](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/730))
在主界面新增常驻的“弹幕控制台”页面，启动外部播放器后可查看当前会话的番剧名称、剧集、媒体路径、播放器进程等信息，并提供关闭播放器按钮。对于 Linux 上的原版 mpv，控制台还能实时显示播放进度和总时长。关联：[#728](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/issues/728)

**外部播放器控制台会话与弹幕实时控制** ([#738](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/738))
控制台可实时显示播放进度、总时长和暂停状态，并新增当前会话的弹幕透明度滑块；重载弹幕后会恢复原有主字幕，保证字幕与弹幕同时正常显示。（透明度调整仅作用于当前会话，实时控制仅适用于带 IPC 的 Linux mpv）

**弹幕透明度与描边控制** ([#736](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/736))
在“设置 > 弹幕”中新增弹幕不透明度滑块（0%–100%）和“启用弹幕描边”开关，设置会立即应用于应用内播放器，外部播放器在下次打开视频时读取最新设置，并统一了不同弹幕渲染器的描边行为。

**目录名称显示模式与首页海报优化** ([#722](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/722))
在“设置 > 外观”中新增“目录名称显示模式”，可选择媒体库目录名称为省略号截断或多行完整显示；首页滚动推荐海报现已支持 WebDAV/SMB/共享媒体库作为数据来源，并降低了模糊遮罩不透明度以提升观感；同时隐藏了 NipaplayUI 中暂不支持的部分设置项。

**Next2 弹幕内核成为默认渲染器** ([#721](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/721))
在支持的平台上默认使用 Next2 弹幕渲染器（不支持时回退到 NipaPlay Next）。Next2、DFM+ 现直接显示在弹幕渲染器菜单中，Next++ 引擎的开关也移入弹幕设置，无需再从实验室功能中开启。

**Android 文件管理器关联优化** ([#720](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/720))
优化了 Android 的意图过滤配置，用户现在可以从系统文件管理器中直接选择 NipaPlay 来播放视频，并扩展了对更多视频格式和链接协议的支持。

## 体验改进

**播放器菜单与进度条打磨** ([#723](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/723))
播放器设置菜单高度根据设置项数量动态调整，避免底部出现大片空白；进度条拖动指示器改为紧凑的胶囊造型，带有悬停动画和更明显的拖动回弹效果。

**播放器面板动态高度** ([#724](https://github.com/AimesSoft/NipaPlay-Reload/pull/724))
播放器各级面板会根据可见项数量自适应高度，内容较少的面板不再留下大片空白。

body:
## Changes in 1.9.1
- Target OBS 32.1.2 (was 32.2 beta)

## Changes in 1.9.0
- Support OBS 32
- Support Metal renderer on macOS (#87)
- Hotfix for possible OOM crash
- Allow high and low cutoffs to be equal
- Improve render quality in waveform mode
- Allow much larger buffer sizes in waveform mode

## Installation
### Windows
Either  
- Use the installer and select your OBS folder.  
or  
- Extract Waveform\_v#.#.#\_Windows\_x86\_64.zip to the *root* of your OBS folder (e.g. `C:\Program Files\obs-studio`).

### Linux (Ubuntu 24.04, Flatpak)
<details>
<summary>Click for instructions</summary>

#### Prebuilt Binaries
- Download Waveform\_v#.#.#\_Ubuntu\_x86\_64.deb and install it using your distro's package manager.  

#### Flatpak
- `flatpak install flathub com.obsproject.Studio.Plugin.waveform`  

#### Source Build

name: spec_driven_develop
body:
## Highlights

- Introduce Delivery Batch as the implementation, integration-validation, and pull-request unit while keeping Issues as atomic planning, acceptance, and telemetry records.
- Default long-running phases to one coherent, reviewable batch pull request instead of one pull request per Issue.
- Support dependency-ready execution waves: lane agents return commits and the orchestrator creates one integrated pull request with one Closes #N line per completed Issue.

## Tracking and Control

- Extend planning and progress templates with Task → Issue → Delivery Batch → PR → Status mapping, in-review and partial states, batch dependencies, and combined validation.
- Keep adaptive-control telemetry per Issue while making the orchestrator the single writer for cumulative drift and shared progress state.
- Synchronize regrouped batch mappings across the plan, MASTER.md, and GitHub Issue bodies.

## Compatibility

- Update the Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode plugin metadata to version 1.14.0.
- Keep installer version detection compatible with both metadata.version and the legacy top-level version field.

name: Auto_Bangumi
body:
# [3.3] — Stable

3.3 is the largest AutoBangumi release in a while: a fully async backend architecture, aria2 promoted to a first-class download backend, movie/OVA/special support, per-bangumi release preferences, a hardened security stack, and a WebUI that updates over SSE instead of polling. REST API behavior is backward-compatible; existing databases upgrade automatically through schema v24.

## 3.3.4 — Authentication, Parser Preview, and safe revision handling

3.3.4 is the stable consolidation of 3.3.4-beta.1 and beta.2. Classic remains
the default parser; Universal Parser Preview and automatic revision replacement
are both opt-in. Existing databases upgrade automatically through schema v24.

- **Authentication (#1074):** adds persistent multi-user sessions, first-run administrator bootstrap, user management, and scoped `api` / `mcp` tokens stored as hashes and revealed only once. Password changes, account disablement, and logout revoke the relevant sessions; browser refresh remains HttpOnly-cookie-only.
- **Universal Parser Preview:** adds a selectable parser for episodes, OVAs/specials, movies, ranges, and mixed collections. Classic remains the stable default, and the two engines never fall back to each other automatically.
- **Safe revision handling (#1078):** the default `hold` policy records and reports revision conflicts. Opt-in `replace` uses a recoverable stage-old → promote-new → clean-up-old flow for qBittorrent and aria2, only after strict identity and revision checks. Automatic replacement is limited to two single-file tasks; collections, incomplete identities, and multiple owners remain held.
- **Calendar (#1077):** archived anime no longer appear on the calendar.
- **Parser fixes (#1072/#1075):** versioned episodes such as `06v2` no longer trigger false offset reviews; TMDB TV and movie searches honor the configured locale; valid `Movie` and CJK movie terms are preserved.

body:
这是 TIANLI0/THRM 的一个预览预发布版本，包含自上一正式版以来的所有变更。请注意，此版本仍在开发中，细节可能还会调整。

This is a preview pre-release of TIANLI0/THRM, containing all changes since the last formal release. Please note that this build is still under development and details may change.

## 更新亮点 / Highlights

- 历史记录图表新增时间线标记（连接/断开/模式切换），提示框统一展示温度与功耗，遥测数据节流减少卡顿，面板延迟加载加快启动。 / History charts now show timeline markers (connect/disconnect/mode changes), a unified tooltip for temperature and power, throttled telemetry to reduce lag, and lazy-loaded panels for faster startup.
- 设备连接恢复指南面板：当设备离线或状态异常时，会显示帮助信息引导您重新连接。 / A new connection recovery guide panel appears when the device is offline or in an unhealthy state, offering step-by-step help to reconnect.
- 诊断功能改进：错误提示从底部条改为更醒目的弹窗通知。 / Diagnostics improvements: error messages now show as prominent toast notifications instead of a bottom bar.
- 侧边栏展开/折叠支持英文、日文和中文。 / Sidebar expand/collapse now supports English, Japanese, and Chinese.
- 关于面板新增致谢部分，列出贡献者和赞助者。 / The About panel now includes a Credits section listing contributors and sponsors.
- 休眠唤醒后设备自动重连更可靠。 / Auto-reconnection after system sleep/wake is now more reliable.
- 温度传感器读数无效时自动回退到可用传感器并采用安全风扇速度，避免过热或停机。 / When temperature readings are invalid, the app falls back to an available sensor and applies a safe fan speed to prevent overheating or shutdown.

## 修复与改进 / Fixes and Improvements

- 修复快速切换风扇曲线时可能生成重复ID导致的配置冲突。 / Fixed a rare ID collision when rapidly switching fan curve profiles, preventing configuration conflicts.
- 修复无效温度读数时的处理逻辑，确保设备安全运行。 / Fixed handling of invalid temperature readings to ensure safe device operation.
- 设备状态界面的温度和转速显示适配不同屏幕尺寸。 / Adjusted responsive styles for temperature and RPM displays on the Device Status page.
- 其他稳定性与性能优化。 / Other stability and performance improvements.
